Metadata.title: SmartSakuu | AI-Powered School Management System for Ghana
Metadata.description: Run admissions, attendance, fees and learner records in one place, and give teachers AI to spot learning gaps, plan lessons and prepare for BECE and WASSCE.

Hero.title:
Run the school.

Understand every learner.

Improve learning.
Hero.body: SmartSakuu gives low-digital-maturity schools infrastructure to create reliable learner records, then uses AI to help teachers identify learning gaps, prepare lessons informed by actual class performance, guide targeted student learning, and measure whether support worked.
Hero.detail: The platform connects the learner’s school journey in one record so schools can spot learning gaps earlier, intervene with the right support, and track whether that support is working.
Hero.footnote: Built for school leaders, teachers, students and parents. Starting in Ghana.

Hero.caption: People at the centre. Always.

Problem.label: The problem
Problem.title: Schools often know the result. They do not always see the pattern behind it.
Problem.body: In many schools, learner information is spread across paper registers, spreadsheets, report cards, notebooks and the knowledge of individual staff members.

gaps.lead: A school may record attendance, fees and examination results, yet still struggle to see:

items.behind: which learners are beginning to fall behind
items.topics: which topics they repeatedly struggle with
items.warning: whether attendance or disengagement is becoming a warning sign
items.support: what support has already been provided
items.dropout: which learners may be at risk of dropping out

score.title:
A learner scores 48%

in Mathematics.
score.body: The school knows the score. But the score alone does not show whether that learner has struggled with Algebra across several assessments, whether performance is declining, whether attendance has changed, what support was previously provided, or whether that support worked.
score.caption: There is more to this learner’s story.

evidence.controlsLabel: Compare a score with the connected record

mastery.empty: The score doesn’t show which topic keeps causing difficulty.

history.empty: One score doesn’t show the trend.

attendance.empty: Attendance sits in a paper register.

support.empty: What was tried sits in a teacher’s notebook.

outcome.value: Not yet. The algebra gap persists.
outcome.empty: No one can easily tell whether the support helped.

evidence.result: The pattern is visible: a persistent algebra gap that last term’s support has not closed.
evidence.resultEmpty: Schools often know what happened. The harder question is why it keeps happening and what should happen next.

closing.title: A learner should not have to struggle repeatedly before someone sees the pattern.
closing.body: The information needed to see that pattern may already exist somewhere in the school. It may also never have been captured in a form the school can use.
closing.statement: SmartSakuu closes the gap between what a school records and what it can understand and act on.

Why.label: Why this matters
Why.title: Learning gaps become harder to address when they are seen too late.
Why.body: Many learners move through school carrying unresolved difficulties from one term to the next.

literacy.body: of children in Ghana do not achieve basic literacy and numeracy by the end of primary school.

schooling.body: expected years of schooling translate into about 5.7 effective learning years.

Why.source: Source: UNICEF Ghana, Education Budget Brief 2025 ↗
Why.imageAlt: Students concentrating on their schoolwork together

statement.lead: The challenge is not simply collecting more data.
statement.emphasis: It is making the information schools already generate useful early enough to intervene and support the learner.

Digitize.label: Why digitize the school?
Digitize.title: Because useful AI starts with reliable information.
Digitize.body: If attendance stays in a paper register, assessment history in spreadsheets, interventions in teachers’ notebooks and important context in people’s heads, neither the school nor AI has a reliable picture to work from.

foundation.lead: That is why school management is not separate from SmartSakuu’s learning proposition.
foundation.processesLabel: SmartSakuu brings everyday school processes into one environment:
foundation.record: As the school operates, those activities progressively create a continuous educational record for each learner.

start.title: Start with the school’s practical needs.
start.body: Schools need reliable systems whether or not they are ready to use AI. Schools can begin with the capabilities they need and expand over time.

steps.operations: The operational system is the entry point.
steps.record: The learner record becomes the intelligence foundation.
steps.ai: AI and learning tools expand the value.

Record.label: The core product idea
Record.title:
One learner. One record.

More useful every term.
Record.body: A learner’s record should show more than marks. One assessment can contribute to a report card, reveal a persistent weak topic, inform the teacher’s next lesson, shape the learner’s revision and help a parent understand where support is needed.
Record.statement: The records used to run the school become records that help the learner.

Value.label: What SmartSakuu changes
Value.title: One connected record. Different value for each person.

leaders.title: School leaders
leaders.body: See academic and operational information without rebuilding the picture from paper files, spreadsheets and separate reports.
leaders.quote: “Which learners need academic support this term, and which learning gaps appear most often?”

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.body: See what the class struggled with before planning what comes next. SmartSakuu combines curriculum requirements with relevant class performance to support more targeted teaching.

students.title: Students
students.body: Receive revision, AI tutoring and BECE/WASSCE preparation focused on the topics that need the most attention instead of treating the entire syllabus equally.

parents.title: Parents
parents.to: “This is where your child needs help, this is what the school is doing, and this is how you can support them.”

Roles.label: AI in context
Roles.title: AI that starts with school context.
Roles.body: Generic AI starts with a blank prompt. SmartSakuu works with the curriculum, assessment history, topic performance and learning activity the school already holds.

teachers.title: A context-aware AI lesson planner
teachers.body: SmartSakuu can draft lesson plans, lesson notes, activities, quizzes, assignments and differentiated exercises.

contextual.title: SmartSakuu can help prepare:
contextual.body: “The next Linear Equations lesson for this JHS 2 class, focusing on the concepts learners struggled with in the previous assessment and providing additional activities for those who need more support.”

control.title: The teacher stays in control
control.body: The teacher reviews, adapts and approves the material before use.

lines: Among learners flagged for support this term, three topics appear most often:

lines: Average JHS Mathematics scores rose from 51% to 56% across the last three terms.
• JHS 1 improved most, after targeted support on fractions.
• JHS 2 dipped this term, mainly in algebra.
Three things need attention today:
• JHS 2B — 9 learners scored below 40% on linear equations, and it has been two weeks since the topic was re-taught.
• Attendance — JHS 1A is down 12% this week, mostly on Mondays and Fridays.
• Fees — 14 families have second-term balances more than 30 days overdue.

Exam.label: Exam preparation
Exam.title: BECE and WASSCE preparation that responds to the learner.
Exam.body: Exam preparation should not always begin with the entire syllabus again. SmartSakuu uses assessment history and learning performance to help students focus on the areas where they need the most work.
Exam.incentives: Incentives reinforce meaningful learning activity, consistency and improvement, rather than rewarding participation alone.

Ghana.label: In use today
Ghana.title: Already being used in Ghanaian schools.
Ghana.body: SmartSakuu is currently deployed in schools in Ghana’s Upper West Region. It is built around GES/NaCCA curriculum structures, supports BECE/WASSCE preparation, and has a partnership with the Wa Municipal branch of the Ghana National Association of Private Schools (GNAPS).
Ghana.measure: We are using these deployments to improve the product and measure what changes for schools, teachers and learners.

local.title: Built around Ghanaian schools. Designed to localize.
local.body: The immediate focus is to make the model work well and demonstrate measurable value in Ghana. From there, curricula, examinations, languages, payment methods and school workflows can be localized for other African education systems.

Memory.label: Institutional memory
Memory.title: The school’s knowledge should not disappear when people leave.
Memory.body: Student history, attendance, academic progress, interventions and institutional information should remain usable even when teachers or administrators change.

example.question: “How has Mathematics performance changed over the last three years?”
example.answer: SmartSakuu uses authorized historical records to show trends and persistent weak areas, linked to the classes, assessments and interventions behind them.
example.note: An example question. Answers depend on the records available to the school.

Responsible.label: Responsible AI
Responsible.title: AI supports people. People remain responsible.
Responsible.body: SmartSakuu is designed so that educational decisions remain with teachers and school leaders.
Responsible.flowLabel: AI drafts, teacher reviews, teacher approves

control.title: Teacher control
control.body: AI-generated lesson plans, notes, quizzes and activities remain drafts until reviewed by the teacher.

access.title: Role-based access
access.body: Users only see information appropriate to their role. Parents see information about their own child.

oversight.title: Human oversight
oversight.body: AI supports teaching, learning and analysis. It does not make autonomous high-stakes decisions about learners.

context.title: Context with boundaries
context.body: AI works with the curriculum and educational information the user is authorized to access.

Headteachers.label: For headteachers
Headteachers.title:
What a connected record

changes for a headteacher.
Headteachers.body: Illustrative scenarios based on common school situations. Approved headteacher stories will replace them.

kumasi.videoLabel: A headteacher smiling in front of her classroom whiteboard
kumasi.quote: Mock results used to arrive in three spreadsheets. With every assessment in one record, the head can see which JHS 3 learners are slipping in mathematics before BECE, and plan support while there is time.

accra.videoLabel: A school leader standing in a classroom while learners work
accra.quote: Parent meetings used to start with a search for paperwork. With attendance, fees and progress in one learner record, the conversation moves straight to what the family and school will do next.
accra.role: Proprietor and head, private basic school

tamale.videoLabel: An educator checking learners’ written work at their desks
tamale.quote: When experienced teachers transfer mid-year, their knowledge of learners stays in the record. New staff pick up each class with its history, and the head can still see how every group has progressed.

takoradi.videoLabel: A headteacher standing proudly beside a learner
takoradi.quote: Between report cards, families have little to go on. Progress updates drawn from the same record let parents see where support is needed before the term ends.
